admin":p=security.Principal{ID:1,Username:"admin",RoleIDs:[]model.ID{1}};default:response.Fail(c,response.ErrUnauthenticated);return};c.Set("principal",p);c.Request=c.Request.WithContext(security.WithPrincipal(c.Request.Context(),p));c.Next()};permit:=func(perm
